labs.title: Manual trigger
labs.hint: Events belong under the top-level trigger key; consult event syntax for the required mapping form.

labs.title: Job and runner
labs.hint: A job declares the execution environment before it can run steps.

labs.title: Push filter
labs.hint: Filters refine a single event and must be nested with that event's configuration.

labs.title: Context as data
labs.task: Map event text to EVENT_TEXT and quote it.
labs.success: No direct context interpolation in run.
labs.hint: Treat context as untrusted data: pass it through an environment boundary and quote shell expansion.

labs.title: Job output
labs.success: prepare maps version from a step output.
labs.hint: A value leaving a job needs an explicit step-to-job output bridge.

labs.title: Consume output
labs.task: Make report need prepare and print its version.
labs.success: report depends on prepare and uses its output.
labs.hint: Cross-job data is available only after an explicit dependency and output declaration.

labs.title: Matrix
labs.hint: A matrix creates one job variation for every listed value.

labs.title: Linux service
labs.task: Add a Redis service and health command.
labs.success: Ubuntu job has healthy Redis service.
labs.hint: Services share a job's lifecycle, so readiness and runner compatibility matter.

labs.title: Reusable call
labs.task: Replace risk.runs-on and risk.steps with uses: './.github/workflows/reusable-risk.yml'; preserve with.sample_size: 3.
labs.success: risk calls the approved reusable path and keeps sample_size 3.
labs.hint: A reusable-workflow call is a job reference, not a runner-backed sequence of steps.

labs.title: Composite action
labs.task: Set runs.using and one run step.
labs.success: Composite action has a safe echo step.
labs.hint: Composite actions describe their execution model and explicitly declare shells for run steps.

labs.title: Failure evidence
labs.success: Evidence step uses always() and GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.
labs.hint: Diagnostic work must be allowed to run after a failing earlier step and preserve its result.

labs.title: Runner policy
labs.hint: Runner labels express scheduling requirements; restrict them to the approved policy vocabulary.

labs.title: Least privilege
labs.success: Top-level permissions are exactly contents: read.
labs.hint: Start from the smallest token capability and avoid broadening it in individual jobs.

labs.title: Job-scoped OIDC
labs.task: Put id-token write and production on deploy.
labs.success: Only deploy has OIDC and it targets production.
labs.hint: Keep cloud identity at the narrowest job boundary and combine it with deployment protection.

labs.title: SHA pin
labs.task: Replace checkout's mutable tag with its verified 40-character release commit SHA from GitHub's action repository.
labs.success: checkout uses one complete 40-character SHA and no suffix.
labs.hint: Immutable references make action review reproducible; verify any candidate against its upstream release.

labs.title: Upload artifact
labs.success: Artifact name and path are exact.
labs.hint: Artifacts preserve named build outputs for later inspection or jobs, unlike dependency caches.

labs.title: Dependency gate
labs.success: deploy needs build and has no write permissions.
labs.hint: Dependencies model required prior work; retain minimal credentials while the gate is evaluated.
